chapter.verse: Ni nih khit ciangin, Galile gam Kana khua-ah mo la lawmvakna om a, Zeisu’ nu zong tua lai-ah a om hi.
Zeisu leh a nungzuite zong lawmvakna-ah a sam uh hi.
Leenggahtui a bei ciangin Zeisu’ nu in Zeisu kiangah, “Leenggahtui a nei kei uh hi,” ci-in a ko hi.
Zeisu in, “Numei aw, kei tawh bang kikum i hi hiam? Ka hun a tung nai kei hi,” a ci hi.
A nu in nasemte kiangah, “Ama hong sawl khempeuh na hih un,” ci-in a gen hi.
Judah mite ngeina bangin, siangtho biakna adingin tua munah seeng nih seeng thum bang a ta thei leibeel guk a kikoih hi.
Zeisu in, “Hih tui beelte tui na dimsak un,” ci-in nasemte a sawl hi.
Tuate in let dektakin a dimsak uh hi. “Tu-in suak un la, lawmvakna pawi ukpa kiangah paipih un,” a cih ciangin a paipih uh hi.
Pawi ukpa in tui a ciap ciangin, leenggahtui suak a, tui tawi nasemte in tua leenggahtui ngahna a theih uh hangin pawi ukpa in a thei kei hi.
Zipipa sam a, “Mi khempeuh in leenggahtui hoihte hawm masa-in, mite in a kham khit uh ciangin a hoih lote a hawm uh hi. Nang in a hoih leenggahtui tudongin na koihcing hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in a masapen hih nalamdang Galile gam Kana khua-ah bawl a, ama minthan’na kilangsakin a nungzuite in zong amah a um uh hi.
Tua nung ciangin a nu akipan a naute leh a nungzuite tawh Zeisu in Kapernaum khua-ah a pai uh hi. Tua khua-ah sawt lo khat a tam uh hi.
Judah mite’ Paisan pawikham hun ahih ciangin, Jerusalem khua-ah Zeisu a paito hi.
Biakna innpi sungah bawngte, tuute, vakhute a zuakte leh sumkheekte tu-a om uh a muh ciangin;
a sat nading khautep a bawl khit ciangin tuate khempeuh, tuu leh bawngte biakna inn sung pan hawlkhia a, sumkheekte’ dangkate bua-in amaute sabuaite a sawnpai hi.
Vakhu zuakte kiangah zong, “Hih nate na paimangpih un. Ka Pa’ inn sumzuakna inn na suaksak kei un,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin a nungzuite in, “Nangma inn ka deih luatna in kei hong netum ding hi,” ci-a a kigelh a phawk uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite in, “Nang in hih bang na hihna tawh bang nalamdang hong lak na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in zong, “Hih biakna innpi na phel gawp uh leh, ni thum sungin ka lamkik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Judah mite in, “Hih biakna innpi kum sawmli leh kum guk tawntung kilam hi. Ni thum bek lam ding na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua bang a genna in ama pumpi biakna inn a cihnopna-in a gen ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, sihna pan a thawhkik ciangin hih thute a nungzuite in phawkkik uh a, Lai Siangtho leh Zeisu thu a um uh hi.
Paisan pawi sung Jerusalem khua-ah a om lai takin, Zeisu in nalamdang a lahte mi tampi in a muh uh ciangin Zeisu a um uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu in amaute’ thu mang lo hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amah in mi khempeuh thei a; mite sungah a omte khempeuh zong thei ahih ciangin, mi khat in midang khat thu ama kiangah a gensak ding a kul kei hi.
